_comment: CMC's one flavour-synergy pair: the Tannic tag (Old Growth Bark, carried by Herb Paste) against vanilla Savoury. Vanilla's FlavourMatrix already holds every pair of its 17 tags, so a pair only does anything when one side is a mod tag. It is what lifts a cooked meat, fish or sausage seasoned with Herb Paste into the +25 Gratification band when eaten.
